_comment: The new-player guide (0.14.0, systems.md 8.3): a short chain of first steps, one at a time, each checked by the server and claimed for ducats; the final purse is paid when the last step is claimed or skipped. check: what the server looks for. activity = an activity row of that type (gathered, crafted); learned = a recipe learned from the trainer; mark = an event the client reports (palazzo: reached the Palazzo; slap: slapped another merchant), since the server can't see those. target: the place the guide points at (3D arrow and pulsing buttons). optional steps can be skipped. Every number is [tune].

steps.title: Collect from your station
steps.hint: Your station has been gathering raw materials. Open it and tap Collect.

steps.title: Craft something
steps.hint: Open your workbench, start a craft, and collect it when it's ready.

steps.title: Learn a recipe from the guild trainer
steps.hint: At your workbench, open the guild trainer (under Recipes) and learn a new recipe. New recipes are how you level up.

steps.title: Walk up to the Palazzo
steps.hint: Take the Steps up to the Palazzo: the marketplace, the Hall of honor and every other merchant are there. On a phone: City → Palazzo.

steps.title: Challenge a merchant (optional)
steps.hint: In the Palazzo, walk up to another merchant and press F (or Slap): a gentlemanly duel challenge, just for fun.
